notes: Each plan is explicit on purpose: the repo does not auto-translate Chinese queries inside the evaluation harness.

Weights default to A/B=3, C/D=2, E/F/G=1 (+1 bonus per extra call, max +4) unless overridden explicitly.
English-source queries may omit unused slots; the harness merges whatever slots are present.
